verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public platform API driven through the edison-client SDK. It covers API-key auth via user-created tokens, task submission with create_task/TaskRequest and a JobNames enum, sync and async retrieval, batch runs with run_tasks_until_done, file upload and artifact management, and long-lived chat sessions with message injection and recovery. The probes also confirm machine-readable markdown docs and an llms.txt index. missing for 10: a published raw REST/OpenAPI specification (OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
